content_of_post_to_answer: If our blood is the same in colour, why are our mind thoughts not the same?
answer: The colour of blood shows our biological similarity, not the sameness of our inner world. Thoughts are shaped by memories, experiences, culture, fears, desires, and the unique way each brain interprets events. Two people can witness the same moment and create different meanings from it. Our shared humanity comes not from thinking alike, but from having the capacity to understand why another person sees differently. A common body does not create a common mind.
